problems.title: Most stores lose sales in
problems.text: These are the problems I check first in every audit. Each one has a direct fix inside Klaviyo.

items.title: New subscribers hear nothing
items.text: Someone gives you their email for a discount and gets one plain code. Then silence for weeks.
items.fix: A 3–4 email welcome series that tells your story and pushes the first order.

items.title: Carts left behind
items.text: Shoppers add products, reach checkout and leave. No reminder ever reaches them.
items.fix: Abandoned cart and checkout flows with product images and a timed nudge.

items.title: A popup nobody fills
items.text: The form looks generic, appears too early, and asks for too much. Your list barely grows.
items.fix: A redesigned popup in your brand style, with better timing and a clear offer.

items.title: Every email to everyone
items.text: Campaigns go to the whole list. Open rates drop and more mail lands in spam.
items.fix: Engagement segments and a send calendar that protects your deliverability.
